entries.title: Psalms 145:1
segments: ¶<<A Praise of David.>> I will extol You, my God, O King; And I will bless Your name forever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 145:2
segments: Every day I will bless You, And I will praise Your name forever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 145:3
segments: Great [is] the LORD, and greatly to be praised; And His greatness [is] unsearchable.

entries.title: Psalms 145:4
segments: One generation shall praise Your works to another, And shall declare Your mighty acts.

entries.title: Psalms 145:5
segments: I will meditate on the glorious splendor of Your majesty, And on Your wondrous works.

entries.title: Psalms 145:6
segments: [Men] shall speak of the might of Your awesome acts, And I will declare Your greatness.

entries.title: Psalms 145:7
segments: They shall utter the memory of Your great goodness, And shall sing of Your righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 145:8
segments: The LORD [is] gracious and full of compassion, Slow to anger and great in mercy.

entries.title: Psalms 145:9
segments: The LORD [is] good to all, And His tender mercies [are] over all His works.

entries.title: Psalms 145:10
segments: ¶All Your works shall praise You, O LORD, And Your saints shall bless You.

entries.title: Psalms 145:11
segments: They shall speak of the glory of Your kingdom, And talk of Your power,

entries.title: Psalms 145:12
segments: To make known to the sons of men His mighty acts, And the glorious majesty of His kingdom.

entries.title: Psalms 145:13
segments: Your kingdom [is] an everlasting kingdom, And Your dominion [endures] throughout all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 145:14
segments: The LORD upholds all who fall, And raises up all [who are] bowed down.

entries.title: Psalms 145:15
segments: The eyes of all look expectantly to You, And You give them their food in due season.

entries.title: Psalms 145:16
segments: You open Your hand And satisfy the desire of every living thing.

entries.title: Psalms 145:17
segments: The LORD [is] righteous in all His ways, Gracious in all His works.

entries.title: Psalms 145:18
segments: The LORD [is] near to all who call upon Him, To all who call upon Him in truth.

entries.title: Psalms 145:19
segments: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear Him; He also will hear their cry and save them.

entries.title: Psalms 145:20
segments: The LORD preserves all who love Him, But all the wicked He will destroy.

entries.title: Psalms 145:21
segments: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD, And all flesh shall bless His holy name Forever and ever.
